text:
alex: hey team :wave: hitting 403 calling hosted sandbox API from my laptop — message: 'IP not allowed'. using HOSTED key from quickstart. Anyone seen this?

devon: are you on VPN? sandbox keys sometimes require IP whitelist for certain internal workspaces. can you paste the curl you used?

alex: not on VPN. curl:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-sandbox-xxxx' -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
getting 403

mira: @alex which key did you use — hosted or CI? hosted sandbox keys generally allowed from any IP, but we have a new security rule for a few workspaces that lock to IPs. check https://go/redwood/sandbox-ip-policy

alex: it's the key from 'Manage > API keys' in console (label: hosted-sandbox). It worked yesterday. woke up to 403 today.

samir: ops rolled a small WAF config to block unknown IPs for dev playpens—sorry. @it-support can you add alex's IP 203.0.113.42 to whitelist for workspace: alex-dev?

it-support: on it — raising request. @alex can you confirm you want permanent whitelist or just until EOD? permanent needs manager OK.

alex: temporary until EOD is fine, thanks.

it-support: done — added 203.0.113.42 for alex-dev until 23:59 UTC. try now.

alex: ok retrying... still 403. curl output: {"error":"quota_exceeded","message":"sandbox quota exceeded for workspace"}

devon: ah quota. Sandbox hosted keys have a daily quota that can be used up by CI tests. check quota with `GET /v1/usage` or see Console -> Billing -> Sandbox Usage.

alex: where do I request more? I don't have billing access.

mira: file a 'sandbox-quota' request in the infra forms: https://go/redwood/infra-requests — choose 'increase sandbox quota' and include workspace name + expected tokens/day. Engineering interns are default 50k tokens/day; you can request bump.

alex: done — request 12345 created. pinging here if anyone from infra can speed it up? starting demo prep in 2 hours.

samir: I can approve temporary bump for demos. @infra-admin can you apply +200k tokens for alex-dev for 4 hours?

infra-admin: Applied +200000 token temporary bump for workspace alex-dev until 4 hours. Also fixed IP whitelist. You should be good.

alex: thanks all! verified generation working. two notes: 1) streaming endpoints give 429 when quota low, 2) curl example for backoff:
```
while true; do curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-sandbox-xxxx' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream || break; sleep 1; done
```
any best practices?

devon: use exponential backoff and check `Retry-After` header. For streaming use smaller chunking and reduce max_tokens.

mira: we also recommend using sandbox CI keys for automated tests (short-lived) and hosted keys for dev + demos. see https://go/redwood/sandbox-keys-guidelines

alex: perfect :thumbsup: closing the loop. thanks everyone.
